ops.text: yasyf box (yBook-Pro): non-interactive HTTPS git push is dead — `origin` is HTTPS, `gh auth status` reports "Failed to log in to github.com account yasyf", and both osxkeychain and git-credential-manager need a TTY. The fusekit WIP snapshot push only succeeded by targeting `git@github.com:yasyf/fusekit.git` directly. Any automation pushing from that machine must use the SSH remote (or fix gh auth + credential helper interactively).
